items.exampleEn: My parents won't permit me to stay out late.

items.exampleEn: Suicide means ending your own life.

items.exampleEn: A prisoner is a person who is kept in a prison.

items.exampleEn: Immigration has changed the city a lot.

items.audioEn: Dogs are not permitted on the beach between May and September.

items.questionZh: 狗什麼時候不能去海灘？

items.sentenceEn: Make sure the door is secure before you leave.
items.sentenceZh: 離開前要確認門關牢了。

items.sentenceEn: The prisoners work in the garden every morning.
items.sentenceZh: 囚犯們每天早上在花園工作。

items.stemEn: The police ____ the man who broke into the school.
items.stemZh: 警方逮捕了那個闖進學校的男子。

items.stemEn: The man who robbed the bank is now in ____.
items.stemZh: 搶銀行的那名男子現在在牢裡。

items.passageEn: When I arrived at the airport, I waited in a long line at immigration. The officer checked my passport and visa carefully. Next to me, a man was arrested because his passport was fake. Two police officers took him away. Later, I read that he was accused of using another person's passport. He will probably go to jail. My friend's father works at a prison in this city. He says most prisoners there take classes to learn new skills. The rules permit them to study for two hours a day. After all this, I felt that the airport was very secure.
items.passageZh: 我到機場時，在入境檢查處排了很長的隊。官員仔細檢查了我的護照和簽證。我旁邊有一名男子因為護照是假的被逮捕，兩名警察把他帶走了。後來我讀到，他被指控使用別人的護照，大概會被關進牢裡。我朋友的爸爸在這個城市的一座監獄工作。他說那裡大部分的囚犯都會上課學新技能，規定允許他們每天讀書兩小時。經過這些事，我覺得這座機場很安全。

questions.questionZh: 朋友的爸爸說那裡大部分囚犯在做什麼？
